name: Imokoi Diary~
source:
Main character meets his female cousin who is a ripe woman already. He can't stop fantasizing about her after reading her diary where she describes her affection towards protagonist. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公遇到了一位已经出落成熟女性的女性表亲。读到她在日记中写下的对主人公的爱意后，他再也无法停止对她的幻想。

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
